design.A1: fronted two-attractor prompt, length 9, subject and final query at position 8
design.A2: two-attractor relative clause, length 11, subject at position 1
design.pairing: same group, same construction and lemma, opposite number; only subject token changes

site.sources: every valid position through the final query; padding excluded

interventions.single_source_value: recipient p_k times same-syntax donor u_k
interventions.joint_all_values: sum of recipient p_k times donor u_k over every valid source

registered_screens.joint_value_sufficiency: joint values recover >=.80 of complete-head margin in every cell
registered_screens.fronted_final_subject_sufficiency: all positions before the changed final subject are exact no-ops; final-subject singleton reproduces joint and recovers >=.80 in both A1 cells
registered_screens.two_attractor_relative_later_relay: each A2 direction cell has a later non-subject singleton with >=.10 recovery, >=.75 donor direction, and positive CE
